title: Why your AC freezes in summer (whiteboard demo)
audience: Homeowners with central AC, seeing this on Instagram or Facebook Reels in early summer

scenes.text: Ice on your AC in July? Here is why it happens.

visual.headline: Ice on your AC in July?

scenes.text: It usually starts small. A dirty filter blocks the air, the coil gets too cold, and it freezes.
Turn the system off and book a tune-up. We clean the coil and check the refrigerant this week.
